item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation is now generally available. It adds timestamp metadata for when each account key was last used, which helps identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise adds credential inventory exports
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise now lets enterprise owners export a complete inventory of credentials that can access the enterprise. The export includes SSH keys, classic and fine-grained personal access tokens, OAuth App access tokens, and other credential types.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Credential revocation and deauthorization by token type
item.description:
GitHub added self-service incident response actions to deauthorize and revoke user credentials by token type and by specific user. The update extends existing credential revocation workflows for security incidents.

  • Source: GitHub
